answer: Quadratic slashing ties each validator's bonded capital to a super-linear penalty curve, so a Sybil cluster of size n incurs cost proportional to n^2 rather than n. the protocol locks basalt collateral in a liquidity-sink that releases only after a deterministic epoch, forcing immediate forfeiture on deviation. a gale of marginal attack cost outpaces the maximum extractable value, and the staking garden reaches an economic security threshold where consensus remains stable.
